mapper.select: SELECT duty, input_date inputDate FROM ( SELECT duty, input_date FROM addressbooklog WHERE target = #{userNo} UNION SELECT description AS duty, input_date FROM loginlog WHERE INSTR( description, '시도한 ID: ' || ( SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_no = #{userNo} ) ) != 0 UNION SELECT duty, input_date FROM todolog WHERE representative_no = #{userNo} ) ORDER BY input_date DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
